name: OpenResearch
description: Run parallel research agents with any model
one_liner: A local app that turns your AI coding assistant into a research assistant that can review papers, form hypotheses, and run experiments for you.
buyer: A university lab or R&D team that wants to speed up literature review and hypothesis generation without hiring more research assistants.
business_use_cases: A university research group uses it to accelerate literature review across a large corpus of papers before starting new experiments.
A corporate R&D team runs exploratory hypothesis generation on internal data before committing budget to full studies.
A science-focused consultancy offers 'accelerated literature review' as a paid service to clients using this as the engine.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for labs that don't want to self-host, priced per seat.
Sell a 'research acceleration' consulting service using it as the delivery engine for clients.

steal_this: Run a real literature-review request for a local grad-student group this weekend and charge a flat fee for a delivered summary report.
